verdict.rationale: Snowflake is a data platform that ships AI features (Cortex AI Functions using third-party LLMs, Cortex Analyst, a managed MCP server), so whether customer data is used for model training is a fair question to ask of it. The pack contains no documented training opt-out, no no-training commitment, and no data-usage policy for its AI features. RBAC, encryption and compliance certifications are adjacent controls and earn no credit for this story.
